sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is the accused.

appropriate direction be issued for disposal of trial in time bound manner.

sentences.text: 1 5. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer made in the present matter by arguing that no such specific reasons have been made out for giving any direction for expediting the trial of the case and as such the application be dismissed.
6. After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that there is no specific reason for expediting the same.

However, the applicant may file an application for expediting the trial before the court concerned within two weeks from today which may as per its load of work, diary and pendency of cases pass appropriate orders on the same within two weeks.
7. It is made clear that this Court has not passed any direction for expediting the trial.
8. The present application is disposed of.
